data.long_meaning: The name Jeelan is derived from the Arabic language and means 'gentle, delicate, beautiful'. It is a name that embodies the qualities of grace and refinement. In Islamic history, Jeelan is said to be the name of a beloved companion of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), known for her kindness and compassion towards all. The name Jeelan carries the meaning “Gentle, Delicate, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jeelan usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
